reflections.summary: Fix aspect (habitual institutional activities, 已经+stop state, 被称为 performance), temporal (no parent for identity/modifier states, chain to main event, no triple for vague time words), non-core roles (:reason for 由于/以而, :place for countries, :medium, :part-of, adverbs as :mod on event), classifier rule (keep :quant 1 :unit 份), title marks as name tokens, superlative have-degree-91, chengyu :mod, but-91 ARG1/ARG2, shared modifiers on conjuncts, no invented arguments, same-event only with same participants; add Examples section.

Temporal: main event to DCT, other events to same-sentence parents with explicit patterns; no invented zero-subject args and full 停止+V structure; 其中 :mod, no :subset, 曾经 :temporal; 未经 without polarity + modal strengths; identity-91 keeps aspect/modal; no event coref across different objects, no :same-entity for events; nested and for coordinated noun pairs; examples added.

Abstract predicates get aspect and modal triples only as clause predicates, never when they reify a noun modifier; connectives get no modal triple. Papers are typed newspaper. No :wiki in Chinese. 以X而闻名: X overlaps the main event. Current-result main events take DCT :depends-on. 闻名 double parent is the one allowed exception. No coref for modifier countries or places. Examples updated.
